The message says the available data cannot answer whether muscle was gained, and names comparable body-composition or circumference measurements, including the need for a starting baseline, as a way to inform whether to continue hypertrophy training or switch to strength. It does not treat HRV or sleep as evidence of muscle gain, claim that a comparison was verified, or present co-occurring notes as causes.
